title: Education Course Player
summary: Keep learners oriented in a course with progress, media playback, and resume across sessions.

strategies.name: Sidebar curriculum + focus player
strategies.tradeoffs: Strong orientation; crowded on small screens.

strategies.name: Up-next autoplay with controls
strategies.when: Video-first platforms optimizing course finish rates.

strategies.name: Spaced quiz gates
strategies.tradeoffs: Learning quality; friction and drop-off risk.

strategies.name: Mobile download for offline lessons
strategies.tradeoffs: Access equity; DRM and storage complexity.
strategies.when: Global learner bases with intermittent connectivity.

neverDo: Lose playback position on tab blur
Autoplay next lesson without an obvious stop
Hide total course duration and remaining time
Ship video-only with no captions path
Block notes behind a separate paywall mid-lesson
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
